meta.title: Fliks: your personal video collection, on every screen
meta.description: Fliks is a self-hosted media server and streaming app for your own video collection. Free, open source, AGPL-3.0.

hero.title: Your personal video collection, on every screen in the house.
hero.subtitle: Point Fliks at the folders where your films and shows live. It handles the rest: covers, synopses, cast, seasons and episodes, laid out like the apps you already use. This library is entirely yours.
hero.imageAlt: The home page, a library, discovery and a film page

features.title: Everything a streaming night needs
features.subtitle: A full streaming service for the whole household, running on hardware you already own.

items.title: Subtitles found for you
items.text: A video with none? Fliks searches the usual subtitle sites and picks the one that matches your copy.

items.title: Translated by AI
items.text: No track in your language? Translate one you have with Gemini, any OpenAI-compatible model or LibreTranslate. Saved next to the video, done once.

items.title: Out of sync, fixed in one click
items.text: Fliks listens to the dialogue and slides the subtitles back onto it. No hunting for the right offset.

items.title: Image subtitles made readable
items.text: DVD and Blu-ray picture subtitles are read by OCR and turned into text you can restyle and translate.

items.title: HDR on any screen
items.text: HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision are tone-mapped to SDR when the screen cannot show them, so the picture never looks washed out.

items.title: Live TV you can pause
items.text: Bring your IPTV playlist: a program guide next to your library, with pause and rewind on live channels.

items.title: Spoiler protection
items.text: Blurs the synopsis and thumbnail of anything you have not watched yet, and hides episode titles that give the plot away.

items.title: Suggestions from what you watch
items.text: Recommendations weighted by what you actually watched, not by what is trending.

items.title: Release calendar
items.text: Upcoming episodes and releases for what you follow, on one calendar.

items.title: Rich metadata
items.text: Posters, cast and crew. Every person gets a page listing their work in your libraries.

items.title: Remote control
items.text: Pick another device from your phone and play there. Pause, seek, switch subtitles or quality from the couch, between any two Fliks apps.

items.title: Quick Connect for TVs
items.text: Pick your profile on the TV, approve it from your phone. No password to type with a remote.

items.title: Recommend something to someone
items.text: Send a film or a season to another user. It shows up on their home page with your name on it.

items.title: Shared playlists
items.text: Invite other users as viewer, editor or admin and build one together.

items.title: Downloads that keep themselves current
items.text: Set a playlist to automatic: what you have not watched is downloaded, what you have watched is removed. Ready before a trip.

items.title: Hardware transcoding
items.text: Intel QSV, VAAPI, NVIDIA NVENC, AMD AMF and Apple VideoToolbox, detected at startup, with a CPU fallback.

items.title: Live transcode dashboard
items.text: Who is watching what, at which quality, on which hardware path, and why a transcode was needed.

items.title: Requests with auto-approval
items.text: Household members ask for titles; rules you set approve the ones you trust.

items.title: Signed, isolated plugins
items.text: Add what you need from the plugin catalog. Archives are signed, and plugin code runs in its own process.

platforms.title: Everywhere you watch

getStarted.subtitle: All you need is a folder with your videos.
getStarted.dockerStep2: Set your media path and passwords, then start it
getStarted.otherWays: Windows and macOS installers are on the releases page.

why.title: Why self-hosted
why.subtitle: The library is yours, and so is the machine it runs on.

items.title: Your data stays home
items.text: No account to create, no subscription, nothing leaves the house.

items.title: Free and open source
items.text: AGPL-3.0-or-later. Read the code, change it, run a modified version.

items.title: No catalog to lose
items.text: Your files, your metadata, your history. Nothing disappears because a license expired.

items.title: Runs on what you have
items.text: A NAS, a spare machine, a home server. Hardware transcoding when the machine offers it.

community.title: Open source, built in the open
community.subtitle: Every change, every release and every discussion happens on GitHub.
